Container.Name: PixelPals
Container.Overview: Pixel Pals: a private AI chat room plus a Today planner, tasks, calendar, notes and server watcher for your home server. Self-hosted, with built-in accounts. This template runs the app on its own; use the Docker Compose Manager file (docker-compose.unraid.yml) if you also want voice input, Ollama, Tailscale or iPhone Reminders sync in one stack.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Pixel Pals web page.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Saved chats, tasks and the server log.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Nightly backups. Point this at a share on another disk to survive a disk failure.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for the morning brief, reminders and Today.

Config.Name: Local AI (Ollama) URL
Config.Description: Optional. Ollama on another machine, for example http://10.200.1.50:11434. Empty turns Local AI off.

Config.Name: Voice input (Whisper) URL
Config.Description: Optional. A Whisper/Speaches server, for example http://10.200.1.30:8000. The Compose file includes one.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional extra password for the whole site.

Config.Name: Phone alerts (ntfy) URL
Config.Description: Optional. Your ntfy topic URL for nudges and the morning brief.

Config.Name: Unraid URL
Config.Description: Optional. This server, for example http://10.200.1.30, for the Unraid watcher.

Config.Name: Unraid API key
Config.Description: Optional. Settings, Management Access, API Keys (read-only is enough).
